info.title: CauseDeck API
info.description: Public REST API. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json; see docs/engineering/api.md.

get.summary: The signed-in user and their workspace memberships
The active plan catalogue (prices in paise, ex-GST)

200.description: The current subscription, or null on the free plan

get.summary: Latest status of one of the workspace’s own cases
Shared cause lists from cleared, non-personal sources
Orders of an own case, or shared published orders from cleared non-personal sources
Official notices from cleared, non-personal sources
Fact-pattern search over anonymised judgments, grouped by judgment

200.description: Judgments with their matching passages, best first; empty when nothing matches

get.summary: The matter’s bench card: neutral sitting facts (flag-gated)

post.summary: Register a webhook endpoint (the secret is returned once)

201.description: The endpoint and its signing secret

get.summary: The workspace's webhook endpoints (never the secret)

delete.summary: Remove a webhook endpoint and its deliveries

post.summary: Razorpay subscription and payment events (signed with X-Razorpay-Signature)

200.description: Accepted (also for replays and unknown subscriptions)

post.summary: Inbound email notifications (SNS-signed for SES, shared secret in dev)

200.description: Accepted (also for duplicates, unknown addresses and disabled channels)

get.summary: WhatsApp webhook subscription handshake (echoes hub.challenge for the verify token)

post.summary: Inbound WhatsApp media (Meta Cloud API webhook, signed with the app secret)

200.description: Accepted (also for duplicates, unknown senders and disabled channels)

post.summary: CSP violation report (`application/csp-report` or `application/reports+json`, 8 KB maximum)

204.description: Accepted: logged and counted, nothing stored
